theme: 3 terms on skipping extra work: a property made on first use, a sequence that works only on demand, and saving results you already calculated

terms.definition: A stored property marked `lazy` whose value is created only when it is first used.
terms.example: Make `formatter` a Lazy Property, so launch doesn't pay for it.

terms.definition: A sequence that runs operations like `map` only when each element is actually needed.
terms.example: With a Lazy Sequence, we stop filtering once we have ten posts.

terms.definition: A technique that saves the result of a function call so the same input is not calculated twice.
terms.example: Add Memoization, so each thumbnail size is calculated only once.

video.description:
Learn to explain how to skip extra work in Swift: Lazy Property, Lazy Sequence & Memoization, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Lazy Property - A stored property marked `lazy` whose value is created only when it is first used.
Lazy Sequence - A sequence that runs operations like `map` only when each element is actually needed.
Memoization - A technique that saves the result of a function call so the same input is not calculated twice.

landscape.title: Swift Lazy Property, Lazy Sequence & Memoization | Day 47
landscape.description:
Explain Lazy Property, Lazy Sequence & Memoization in Swift by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
지연 프로퍼티, 지연 시퀀스, 메모이제이션 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Lazy Property - A stored property marked `lazy` whose value is created only when it is first used.
한국어: 지연 프로퍼티: lazy를 붙여, 처음 쓰일 때 비로소 값이 만들어지는 저장 프로퍼티

Lazy Sequence - A sequence that runs operations like `map` only when each element is actually needed.
한국어: 지연 시퀀스: map 같은 연산을 각 요소가 실제로 필요할 때만 실행하는 시퀀스

Memoization - A technique that saves the result of a function call so the same input is not calculated twice.
한국어: 메모이제이션: 함수 호출 결과를 저장해 같은 입력을 두 번 계산하지 않게 하는 기법

In this video, Mina and Jake sort out why a screen opens slowly, how to filter only what you show and how to stop calculating the same thing twice, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: Can you explain lazy and memoization in English?

dialogue.title: Why is the feed slow?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the feed screen is slow to open. Any ideas?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Your `formatter` is created right away. Make it a Lazy Property.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So it's made only when I first use it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. A Lazy Property waits until the first read.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I also filter all of `ids`, but I only show ten.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then use a Lazy Sequence. Add `.lazy`, and it stops once it has ten.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nice. So a Lazy Sequence skips the rest?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. But titles are calculated again on every scroll.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Wait, isn't that what `cache` is for?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, that's Memoization. Save each title once, then read it from `cache`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Got it. Lazy Property, Lazy Sequence and Memoization all skip extra work.
A Lazy Property isn't built until someone reads it.
